properties.summary: Defines Hallmark's output contract: design tokens in :root, semantic naming, append-only global stylesheets, genre/tone stamp. Scope: taste skill only — no product copy, brand identity, or business logic.

Copy guidelines: specific verbs, active voice, error messages in three parts, empty states in three beats, loading states. Seven voice tones (Editorial, Brutalist, Soft, Technical, Luxury, Playful, Austere) with real-site opening-line samples. Banned anti-pattern openers.

Six craft tiers: A (Pure CSS art), B (Hand-built SVG), C (Declarative animation with @property/scroll-driven/View Transitions), D (Three.js/WebGL), E (Generated stills: Nanobanana, Recraft, Midjourney, Flux), F (Library illustrations/Lottie, last resort). Includes recipe library with 4 worked examples.

Two routes: catalog (20 named themes) vs custom (tuned — one-off OKLCH palette + font pairing; or bespoke — full page from first principles). Palette construction in OKLCH order, font pairing across tones, three-axis diversification rule. Three worked examples.

Opt-in portable design system format. Two emission paths (default verb lock vs study verb lock). Triggered by phrases like 'lock the system'. No-overwrite policy. ~45-line format with system, tokens, CTA voice, motion stance, exports sections.

Four canonical formats: tokens.css (source of truth), Tailwind v4 @theme, DTCG tokens.json, shadcn/ui CSS variables. tokens.css always emitted; others inline in design.md. Full token taxonomy with OKLCH values.

Recipe for N10 Floating-on-scroll nav. Four non-negotiable laws: constant total height, translateY offset, cross-fade ownership of every shared visual, single timing curve. 10-property morph table. Scroll handler with passive listener, rAF throttle, boolean-flip guard. 8 anti-patterns.

Dark canvas with warm radial blooms, confident sans display, single warm accent. For AI/creative product pages. Themes: Bloom, Midnight, Terminal, Aurora, Lumen. Disallows light-paper, italic headers, glassmorphism, gradient text. Centred heroes allowed. Radial-gradient blooms up to 2.

Canonical Hallmark voice. Roman serif or condensed sans display, workhorse serif body, single warm/cool accent, asymmetric layout, quiet motion. 12 themes: Specimen, Newsprint, Atelier, Garden, Almanac, Studio, Riso, Sport, Brutal, Manifesto, Editorial, Carnival. Default nav N6 Newspaper masthead.

Polished enterprise/dev-tool/API page genre. Geist sans, large confident displays, pill CTAs, monochrome with optional accent. Themes: Coral (warm-grey, coral, Geist, pills) and Cobalt (cool-white, electric blue, Space Grotesk, tight-radius). Default nav N5 Floating pill.

Consumer/friendly/onboarding-led genre. Soft surfaces, mild colour, hover-responsive motion. Theme: Hum (rounded-sans-multi-accent, vibrant, mandatory motion). Low-chroma accents, soft drop shadows, 12px radius. Bans saturated consumer-app pinks, emoji-as-decoration, Comic Sans.

Image-need detection table, enrichment hierarchy (Typography only → Custom CSS art → Hand-built SVG → Generated illustration → Library → Lottie), eight enrichment archetypes (E1 Demo Video Clipped, E2 Full-bleed loop, E3 Browser-framed mockup, E4 Floating no-frame, E5 Custom Illustration, E6 Animated Loop, E7 Abstract Background, E8 Photography), four polish patterns (HP1-4), hero space discipline, animation discipline, eight pre-flight quality questions.

Curated abstract assets hosted at usehallmark.com/imagery/. Six categories: watercolor, transparent, ornament, texture, silhouette, pattern. Usage patterns: layered hero composition, section background wash, decoration, texture overlay, empty states. Anti-patterns: not for subject replacement, max 2-3 pieces per page, not for modern-minimal genre.

Eight interaction states (Default, Hover, Focus, Active/Pressed, Disabled, Loading, Error, Success). Focus rings with :focus-visible. 44px minimum hit targets. Form discipline: labels above inputs, validate on blur, error messages in three parts. Input field no-layout-shift rule. Contrast discipline with APCA computation.

4pt spacing scale (--space-3xs to --space-4xl). Grid principles (CSS Grid for page layout, Flexbox for components). Asymmetry techniques: wide left margin, offset grids, grid-breaks, varied padding. Depth via weight/scale not shadows. Six-level z-index scale. Page-edge clipping with overflow-x: clip.

21 named landing-page shapes: Bento Grid, Long Document, Marquee Hero, Stat-Led, Workbench, Conversational FAQ, Manifesto, Photographic, Quote-Led, Specimen, Catalogue, Letter, Index-First, Narrative Workflow, Split Studio, Feature Stack, Type Specimen, Portfolio Grid, Map/Diagram, Ecosystem Index, Component Playground. Modular blocks of varying sizes in an irregular grid. 8-15 blocks of mixed spans. Centered display in fixed-height hero. 12-24px gap, no rules. For feature pages, SaaS landings, multiple entry points.
Continuous prose with inline section heads. Single column, line-height 1.65+, measure 60-65ch. Typographic link CTAs inside paragraphs. For case studies, founder posts, philosophical products.

Single bold statement fills viewport. 8-14vw type hugging viewport edges. No subhead or CTA in fold. Below-fold becomes list or content block. For designer/director portfolios, indie products with singular voice.

Giant number/metric as hero, always paired with worded headline. 8-12rem tabular figures. Sections anchored by supporting stats. Number-tick reveal animation. For enterprise/B2B with defensible metrics.
Product screenshots in frames as primary content. Small functional heading. Sticky-bottom CTA after third screenshot. For SaaS, developer tools, IDE extensions.
Bold questions as headings, 2-4 paragraph answers. Collapsible accordions with 200ms ease-out on grid-template-rows. For pricing pages, skeptical audiences, regulated industries.

properties.summary: Designed in Figma, optimized via SVGOMG, inlined in HTML, animated declaratively. Pipeline: design → export → SVGOMG → inline → animate. 4-15KB typical. For articulated figures, organic curves, multi-element scenes CSS can't express cleanly.

CSS-first animation: @property for typed custom property interpolation, animation-timeline scroll()/view() for scroll-driven, View Transitions API for state changes. Motion (6KB) for React entrances, GSAP (50KB) for complex timelines. Decision rule table for when to use each.

Build palette in order: anchor accent (chroma 0.12-0.20), paper (L tinted toward anchor, chroma 0.005-0.020), ink (L 16-24% light / 88-96% dark, tinted chroma 0.005-0.014), supporting greys (stepped by 6-10% L), focus (accent hue, chroma 0.18-0.22), accent-ink (≥ APCA 7:1). Verification gates.

Plain CSS custom properties at :root. Always emitted alongside page CSS. Names: --color-paper, --color-ink, --color-accent, --font-display, --font-body, --space-3xs to --space-5xl, --text-xs to --text-display, --ease-*, --dur-*, --radius-*, --shadow-card. Never overwrite existing entry stylesheet.

Duo-tone accent system (mustard + oxblood), chunky variable display, decorative ornaments, hard-offset shadows. The loud sibling to Riso/Manifesto/Brutal. For Dropout TV / Fly.io / Stones Throw / Third Man Records register.

Cool engineered near-white paper, one electric cobalt signal accent, Space Grotesk display + Inter body + JetBrains Mono code, ruler-drawn hairlines, tight 6px radii, bordered ⌘K nav, live code/API request-response hero. Technical sibling to Coral's warmth.

Four structural layout/type/motion patterns: HP1 Vertical-rail title (writing-mode: vertical-rl), HP2 Marquee-overflow (headline larger than viewport), HP3 Cursor-spotlight (mousemove radial-gradient scoped to hero), HP4 Decorative-numeral (edition/year/chapter glyph). Mutually exclusive on a single hero.

Eight archetypes: E1 Demo Video Clipped-by-viewport-edge, E2 Full-bleed muted loop with ghost overlay, E3 Browser-framed mockup split, E4 Floating no-frame screenshot, E5 Custom Illustration Centerpiece, E6 Animated Loop (pure CSS/SVG), E7 Abstract Background (gradient + grain), E8 Hero Photography.

2-3px outline, ≥3:1 contrast, 2px offset, :focus-visible only (not :focus). Never outline:none without replacement. --color-focus defaults to accent at higher chroma. Most common accessibility bug is missing focus replacement.

Nine steps: --space-3xs (2px), --space-2xs (4px), --space-xs (8px), --space-sm (12px), --space-md (16px), --space-lg (24px), --space-xl (40px), --space-2xl (64px), --space-3xl (96px), --space-4xl (144px). Use gap for sibling spacing, margin only for optical adjustments.

Before picking, check codebase for existing /* Hallmark · macrostructure: <name> */ stamp. Pick must be different from last. First ten macrostructures cover ~80% of briefs and should be preferred over 11-21 when brief is vague.

For Bento Grid/Stat-Led/Workbench/Marquee Hero SaaS pages: Hero → Social proof/logo wall → Features → Testimonials → Pricing → FAQ → Final CTA strip → Footer. Each section separated by --space-3xl minimum. Pricing shows actual price. Testimonials include role AND company.

1) Total nav height stays constant between states. 2) Visible offset uses transform: translateY(), never padding/margin. 3) Cross-fade ownership of every shared visual — explicitly neutralise in opposite state. 4) Single timing curve across every property (~520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)).

Defines typed custom properties (color, length, angle, number, percentage) that browsers can interpolate smoothly in animations. Baseline 2024, ~88% support by 2026. Enables GPU-composited declarative animation without JS. Used across all craft tiers for animation.

Four copy-paste-able recipes at Tier A/B: 1) Workflow/process diagram (three boxes + animated stroke-dashoffset arrows), 2) Minimal-line mascot (face SVG with blink animation), 3) Three-tier architectural diagram (browser → API → database), 4) Botanical leaf flourish (hand-drawn sprig). Cross-recipe techniques: @property, asymmetric rotate, opacity layering, mono labels.

Hero takes 70-90% of first viewport height. min-height: clamp(60vh, 75dvh, 88dvh). padding-block-end ≥ 1.3x padding-block-start. Never centre everything (max 2 centred elements). Headline typography: tight tracking -0.02 to -0.04em, line-height 0.95-1.05 for display. One polish pattern max. Content must fit fold without scrolling.
Polemical large type, declaration energy, political-poster aesthetic. Sells agreement not action.
Single huge image dominates each fold. Design says look before read. Small caption annotations.
Hero is a pull-quote with attribution. Headline is borrowed credibility, social proof.
Numbered left-margin labels, huge serif display, asymmetric column spans. BANNED AS DEFAULT.
